title: Workbench
description: Apple-style multi-pane workbench: custom project groups, a conversation console (对话后台), a node-based mind map (6 structure presets, nodes carrying text and pictures), a daily-news reader (today's world events plus your own keyword topics, kept for up to 7 days, 10-100 stories, with automatic Chinese translation of English headlines), a market board, and a screen recorder (the whole screen straight to MP4, optional microphone, files land in your Videos folder and can be played, revealed or deleted); also a conversation node tree, per-turn summaries and a resource vault (usage and token meter).
